t: This is the Instituto Español Vicente Cañada Blanch, a Spanish independent day school in Notting Hill, in the Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea. The Spanish government owns it, and it works under the supervision of the Education Office of the Spanish Embassy. Its curriculum is accredited by Spain's Ministry of Education. Inspectors from both the Independent Schools Inspectorate and the Spanish educational inspectorate check it regularly. The school is named after Vicent Cañada Blanch, who founded it.
